definitions.population: g15 candidate centers at every available production analysis boundary, grouped by seed and channel
definitions.deduplication: Within each boundary and channel, count every center row; count each referenced captureId once. Duplicate center observations equal row count minus unique capture ids.
definitions.nucleusConvention: For each boundary/channel/captureId, choose its lowest row-major g15 center index. angularSpan, maxRadius, and chosen-center entry distance come from that exact center record. This is a reporting convention, not a selector.
definitions.quantiles: Nearest observed order statistic at rank round((n - 1) * p), matching the local-opportunity core convention; mean is arithmetic.
definitions.materialContext: materialLayerCellObservations pools layerHistogram cell counts across deduplicated X observations; repeated cells across boundaries remain repeated context.
definitions.interpretation: X geometry is a descriptive mask around candidate centers, not a material object, opportunity law, or selection rule.
